change_summary: Changed the hardcoded grid `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 128),)` to a lambda `lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, meta['XBLOCK']),)` so the launch grid dynamically adapts to whichever XBLOCK the autotuner selects, enabling proper SM saturation instead of always launching 512 CTAs.
